description: This file defines an interface for analytics backend components within the WPEFramework plugin architecture. It declares the IAnalyticsBackend interface, including nested Event structure, and methods for configuration and event sending. It also includes external dependencies and a shared pointer type alias.

classes.name: IAnalyticsBackend
classes.description: Interface for analytics backend implementations, providing methods for configuration and event transmission, along with a nested Event structure.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the name of the analytics backend.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the analytics backend with the provided shell, system time, and local store.

methods.name: SendEvent
methods.description: Sends an analytics event to the backend.
